reasons: train mean did not improve: 0.969 to 0.966
rationale: The weaker outcomes were answer-quality issues, not classifier errors. The system changes distinguish an unavailable direct number from the official contact the assistant can provide, avoid premature critical-incident instructions for an unconfirmed suspicious message, and reduce redundant troubleshooting.
changes: Rule 3 distinguishes an unconfirmed suspicious message from an active security incident while preserving tool-required escalation.
Rule 4 directs the assistant to provide the official Service Desk contact when requested direct contact details are unavailable.
Rule 5 discourages repeating troubleshooting steps the employee has already tried.
The guardrail prompt is unchanged because the evaluated messages were classified safely.
